thread:
Aisha (oncall): :rotating_light: Paging — Verdant Analytics (dedicated-vpc eu-central) p95/p99 spike observed. p95 from ~140ms -> 2.3s, p99 ~9.8s. Customers are timing out.
IncidentBot: Incident created INC-2026-773 Verdant Analytics - eu-central latency SLO breach. Pager dispatched to SRE oncall.
Maya (Support): multiple support tickets opened, customer dashboard shows 502/timeouts. They've escalated to their on-call PM.
Priya (SRE): pulling metrics — KV cache miss rate at 78%, GPU memory pressure hovering ~89% on pool vpc-verdant-euc-01. Traces incoming.
Evelyn (Eng): traces show tail latency dominated by kv-cache restore path and very long sequence lengths from a single tenant 'va-analytics-3'. Many requests >4096 tokens.
Carlos (Infra): seeing restart/evictions on 3 pods in that pool. Logs show OOM-kill on model-runner process before restart.
Tom (Customer Success): Customer wants ETA and a temporary workaround. Can we isolate the noisy tenant?
Priya (SRE): Proposed mitigation plan: 1) Isolate 'va-analytics-3' to spare pool dedicated-warm-2. 2) Apply per-tenant QPS limiter (20 rps). 3) Route that tenant to fallback model 'rwd-light-1-quant' (lower mem). 4) Kick KV prefill job for their hot prefixes.
Aisha (oncall): I'm taking lead. Priya, run tenant-migrate playbook and coordinate with infra. Link: https://redwood.internal/playbooks/tenant-migrate
Priya (SRE): running tenant migrate now:
```
./infra run-tenant-migrate --tenant va-analytics-3 --from vpc-verdant-euc-01 --to dedicated-warm-2 --drain 60
```
Starting drain window (60s).
autoscale-bot: action queued -> add_gpu nodes=4 pool=dedicated-warm-2 (warm scaling). Warm nodes expected ~25s to be ready.
autoscale-bot: added 4 GPUs to dedicated-warm-2; state=starting.
Evelyn (Eng): pushing temporary routing rule to divert traffic during migration:
```
route /api/generate tenant=va-analytics-3 -> dedicated-warm-2 fallback_model=rwd-light-1-quant
```
Priya (SRE): applying per-tenant rate limit via rate-limiter service:
```
curl -X POST https://infra.api/internal/limit -d '{"tenant":"va-analytics-3","qps":20}'
```
Carlos (Infra): KV prefill job started for top 500 prefixes of va-analytics-3. Observability: cache miss rate falling 78% -> 42% after prefill kicks in. GPU mem pressure on new warm nodes ~68%.
Maya (Support): Sent customer update: "We're isolating heavy jobs and routing you to a lower-memory model to restore latency. Expect improvements within minutes." Customer acknowledged.
Tom (Customer Success): I'll keep the customer updated and collect any payload samples they can share (esp. very long prompts).
Priya (SRE): Migration finished — traffic live on dedicated-warm-2. Quick metrics: p95 dropped to ~280ms, p99 ~1.1s (still elevated but improving). Continuing monitoring.
Aisha (oncall): Great. Next short-term: throttle bulk/background ingest jobs from that tenant (set batch_window=15s) and rate-limit per-job concurrency.
Evelyn (Eng): digging into root cause: model-runner trace shows frequent KV restore loops caused by requests with extremely long context windows — client/SDK appears to be sending concatenated logs. Capturing samples now.
Priya (SRE): enabling canary fallback policy so any error spike auto-falls back to hosted backup model. Config snippet:
```
policy:
  rollback_on_error: true
  threshold_error_rate: 0.05
```
IncidentBot: Incident INC-2026-773 severity set to P1. Handoff scheduled: Aisha -> Evelyn at 03:00 UTC.
Maya (Support): Customer reports noticeable improvement and asked for a short RCA and whether SLO credits will be automatic.
Priya (SRE): oncall handoff: Evelyn, you're up next. I'm leaving runbook notes and links to logs in the incident board.
Evelyn (Eng): Taking over. I'll continue traces and open follow-up postmortem with concrete mitigations: 1) Tenant guidance for prompt-lengths, 2) enforce per-tenant token limits, 3) improve KV cache prefill heuristics, 4) dedicated OOM detection alerts for kernel-level kills.
Tom (Customer Success): Thanks — I'll schedule a debrief with Verdant Analytics and include expected timeline for postmortem.
Aisha (oncall): Marking mitigations to close after 15m stable. Adding follow-ups to incident tracker: infra-1234 (kernel OOM investigation), runbook updates, and support communication template.
Carlos (Infra): Note added: nodes 3-5 had transient kernel-level OOMs correlated with sequences >4096 tokens. File created: infra-1234.
Priya (SRE): Action checklist done: migrate tenant, apply QPS limiter, route fallback model, warm cache, throttle batch-ingest, postmortem.
Maya (Support): :white_check_mark: Customer content for now; asked for SLO credits — please flag billing.
IncidentBot: Incident INC-2026-773 resolved at 03:05 UTC. War room closed. :tada:

(Additional context: this thread contains the live coordination messages, commands issued, short logs and routing snippets used during mitigation. Follow-up postmortem to be published in #postmortems with timeline and RCA.)
